# Reference

Every concept of the approach, its type and definition, and the checks that hold it, generated from [ontology.md](../ontology.md) and [checks.md](../checks.md). Automatic checks are enforced by the tool; manual checks are what a reviewer does, because the tool cannot. The pages of this directory explain the parts; this page is what they refer to.

| Entity    | Retired ID         | `ent.retired-id`              |                          | An ID that had to change, kept so that the decision log, which is never edited, still resolves. |

| Invariant | Not defined again  | `inv.retired-not-defined`     |                          | A retired ID has no definition row.                                                             |
| Invariant | Only in the log    | `inv.retired-only-in-log`     |                          | A retired ID appears nowhere but the decision log.                                              |
| Invariant | Replacement exists | `inv.replacement-exists`      |                          | The replacement of a retired ID has a definition row.                                           |

| Invariant | Departure well formed         | `inv.departure-well-formed`       |                                  | An entry with an Extends: or Overrides: line has Layer: process, and every such line names concepts of the approach that exist and, while the entry is in force, are not retired.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Action    | Answer a tentative entry      | `action.answer-tentative`         |                                  | The owner takes the recommendation, picks another option or drops the question: the entry is accepted, rewritten and accepted, or withdrawn; an accepted one names the answer on its Source: line.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Action    | Supersede a decision          | `action.supersede-decision`       |                                  | Write a new entry that replaces the old one whole and says why.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

## Implementation row

| Kind      | Term                    | ID                                | Type             | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Implementation row      | `ent.implementation-row`          |                  | A claim that one or more concepts exist in the product, with the files and a note on what is partial.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Field     | Files                   | `field.implementation-row.files`  | text             | Paths of the files that realise the concept.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Field     | Note                    | `field.implementation-row.note`   | text optional    | What is partial or missing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Relation  | Concepts                | `edge.implementation-row.concept` | refs ent.concept | The concepts the row claims; concepts realised in the same files may share a row.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Derived   | Named in code           | `derived.named-in-code`           |                  | The files that name a concept in an ont: comment: those of the implementation table and of the code directories the configuration lists; --coverage shows them, and the check lists implemented concepts that the files of their row do not name, as information unless the configuration requires names (inv.implemented-named). |
| Rule      | Code names its concepts | `rule.code-names-concepts`        |                  | Code that implements a concept names its ID next to it in a comment, // ont: inv.no-renew-when-held; a name is not an implementation, so the implementation table still says where a concept is built.                                                                                                                            |
| Rule      | Updated with the code   | `rule.table-with-code`            |                  | A change to behavior updates the implementation table in the same change.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Rule      | Partial noted           | `rule.partial-noted`              |                  | The note of a partial row names the target concept that adds what is missing; no note means complete as far as the author knows.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Invariant | Code names resolve      | `inv.code-names-resolve`          |                  | Every ID that code names in an ont: comment is defined and not retired.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Invariant | Files exist             | `inv.implementation-files-exist`  |                  | Every file the table names exists.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Invariant | Row is true             | `inv.implementation-true`         |                  | The files a row names do realise the concept.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Invariant | Implemented is named    | `inv.implemented-named`           |                  | When the configuration sets codeNames.require, every implemented concept is named in an ont: comment in a file of its row, so a cleanup that deletes the name fails the check.                                                                                                                                                    |
| Invariant | Code has an owner       | `inv.code-has-owner`              |                  | When the configuration sets codeNames.owner, every file of the code directories names, in an ont: comment, at least one concept the ontology defines.                                                                                                                                                                             |

| Check                                          | Concepts                                     | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                                         | WHEN                                | THEN                                                                                                                                  | Proof  |
| ---------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.implementation-row.missing-file`        | `inv.implementation-files-exist`             | a row names a file that does not exist                                                                                                                                        | the check runs                      | it names the file and fails                                                                                                           | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.grouped`             | `edge.implementation-row.concept`            | `edge.loan.item` and `edge.loan.member` share one row with one file                                                                                                           | the check runs                      | both count as implemented                                                                                                             | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.code-name-unknown`   | `inv.code-names-resolve`                     | `app/library.mjs` names, in an `ont:` comment, an ID the ontology does not define, and elsewhere uses a property path that looks like an ID without such a comment            | the check runs                      | it names the ID and the file, and fails; the code without the comment is not read                                                     | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.code-name-retired`   | `inv.code-names-resolve`                     | `app/library.mjs` names `field.due-date`, which the ontology retired for `field.loan.due-date`                                                                                | the check runs                      | it names the ID and its replacement, and fails                                                                                        | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.unnamed-in-code`     | `derived.named-in-code`                      | `derived.queue-position` is implemented in `app/library.mjs`, and the file does not name it                                                                                   | the check runs, then `--coverage`   | it lists `derived.queue-position` as information and passes; `--coverage` shows, for each implemented concept, the files that name it | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.unnamed-required`    | `inv.implemented-named`                      | the configuration sets `codeNames.require`, and `app/library.mjs`, the file of the row of `derived.queue-position`, does not name it                                          | the check runs                      | it fails and names `derived.queue-position`                                                                                           | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.ownerless-required`  | `inv.code-has-owner`                         | the configuration sets `codeNames.owner`, and `app/format.mjs` in a code directory names no defined concept: no `ont:` comment, or one whose IDs the ontology does not define | the check runs                      | it fails and names the file; a file that names a defined concept, or that the directory's `match` leaves out, passes                  | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.ownerless-file`      | `inv.code-has-owner`                         | the configuration does not set `codeNames.owner`, and `app/format.mjs` in a code directory has no `ont:` comment                                                              | the check runs                      | it lists the file as information and passes                                                                                           | auto   |

| `check.implementation-row.true`                | `inv.implementation-true`                    | a row of the implementation table                                                                                                                                             | a reviewer opens the files it names | they realise the concept                                                                                                              | manual |
| `check.implementation-row.code-names-concepts` | `rule.code-names-concepts`                   | code that implements a concept                                                                                                                                                | a reviewer reads it                 | an `ont:` comment next to the code names the concept                                                                                  | manual |

## Divergence

| Kind      | Term                   | ID                              | Type             | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Divergence             | `ent.divergence`                |                  | A place where the product does something the target does not want.                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Field     | Description            | `field.divergence.description`  | text             | What the product does instead, and the ticket or decision that will settle it.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Relation  | Concepts               | `edge.divergence.concepts`      | refs ent.concept | The concepts involved.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Rule      | Only contradictions    | `rule.divergence-contradicts`   |                  | A divergence records behavior that contradicts the target; what is not built yet is the gap, not a divergence.                                                                                                                                                   |
| Rule      | Becomes work           | `rule.divergence-becomes-work`  |                  | Each divergence becomes a ticket, or a decision when the target was what changed.                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Rule      | Second vocabulary      | `rule.second-vocabulary`        |                  | A project may keep the vocabulary of what shipped apart from the target's; where they disagree, it is a divergence, never a silent edit of either.                                                                                                               |
| Invariant | Concepts named         | `inv.divergence-names-concepts` |                  | Every line under known divergences names at least one concept by ID.                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Action    | Walk the product blind | `action.walk-blind`             |                  | Use the product as a user, from the ontology, the catalogue, the map and the run guides but not the code: behavior that contradicts the target becomes a known divergence, a case the catalogue lacks becomes a check, and what is not built is already the gap. |

| Check                                  | Concepts                                                 | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                | WHEN                        | THEN                                                                                                                                                             | Proof  |
| -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.divergence.no-concept`          | `inv.divergence-names-concepts`                          | a line under known divergences names no concept by ID                                                                                                | the check runs              | it quotes the line and fails                                                                                                                                     | auto   |
| `check.divergence.walk-blind`          | `action.walk-blind`                                      | a blind walk found that renewal goes through while someone waits, that the hold queue is not served, and that nothing says what a damaged item shows | a reviewer reads its report | the walker had no access to the code; the renewal became a known divergence, the case of the damaged item a check, and the queue nothing new, since it is target | manual |
| `check.divergence.only-contradictions` | `rule.divergence-contradicts`                            | a new line under known divergences                                                                                                                   | a reviewer reads it         | it describes behavior that contradicts the target, not something missing                                                                                         | manual |
| `check.divergence.becomes-work`        | `rule.divergence-becomes-work`, `rule.second-vocabulary` | a known divergence                                                                                                                                   | a reviewer reads the list   | it points at a ticket or a pending decision, and neither side was edited to hide it                                                                              | manual |

| `check.mockup-element.fictional-data`           | `rule.mockup-data-fictional`                  | a mockup shared outside the team                                       | a reviewer reads its data                | it holds no real names or records                                                     | manual |

| Entity    | Check                       | `ent.check`                     |                             | A case with data that must hold for any implementation, in the product's terms.                                                                                                                                                        |

| Concept   | Ontology layer              | `concept.ontology-layer`        |                             | What the tool checks in any project: the ontology and the artifacts that refer to it.                                                                                                                                                  |
| Concept   | Product layer               | `concept.product-layer`         |                             | What a project's catalogue and tests check: the product that agents build from the ontology.                                                                                                                                           |
| Concept   | Completeness axis           | `concept.completeness-axis`     |                             | A fork along which behavior diverges, with its values. Every action has the outcome axis: success, refusal, empty, error, silence; a project may add axes of its own.                                                                  |
| Rule      | In the product's terms      | `rule.check-in-product-terms`   |                             | GIVEN, WHEN and THEN use concrete data from a fixed sample and the product's words; no function names, commands or selectors.                                                                                                          |
| Rule      | Unreachable reported        | `rule.unreachable-reported`     |                             | A manual check that could not be run is reported as not run, never verified through another path.                                                                                                                                      |
| Rule      | Evidence kept               | `rule.manual-evidence-kept`     |                             | Evidence of a manual check is kept outside the repository, named by check and date.                                                                                                                                                    |
| Rule      | Chosen values checked       | `rule.chosen-value-checked`     |                             | A value a decision chose, or a target that is a requirement, is held by an automatic check; a model's assumptions are held by a snapshot of its base scenario's results, never by a check that the model reaches its goal.             |
| Rule      | The judge sees the check    | `rule.judge-sees-the-check`     |                             | A judge gets the check's GIVEN, WHEN and THEN and the product's output, not the code or the test.                                                                                                                                      |
| Rule      | Verdict kept                | `rule.verdict-kept`             |                             | The verdict of a judged check is kept outside the repository, named by check and date, like the evidence of a manual check.                                                                                                            |
| Rule      | Each state of a view judged | `rule.view-state-judged`        |                             | Every state of an implemented view that the view's note describes has a judged check: in that state, a snapshot of the view shows what the note says for it.                                                                           |
| Rule      | Screens kept                | `rule.screens-kept`             |                             | A run of a view's judged checks keeps the snapshot of each screen, and its image where the product can take one, outside the repository, named by the view, the state and the date, so that the owner judges layout and style on them. |
| Rule      | No redundant check          | `rule.check-not-redundant`      |                             | Two checks whose cases differ only in data, not in behavior, are one: a check whose removal loses no value or combination of values that the others cover goes.                                                                        |
| Invariant | Unique                      | `inv.check-ids-unique`          |                             | No check ID is used twice.                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Invariant | In its section              | `inv.check-in-its-section`      |                             | A check's ID names the key of the catalogue section it sits in: the code span in the heading, or else the heading's Latin letters and digits in lowercase.                                                                             |
| Invariant | Well formed                 | `inv.check-well-formed`         |                             | A check has concepts, GIVEN, WHEN, THEN and a proof: auto, judged or manual.                                                                                                                                                           |
| Invariant | Checks before code          | `inv.required-concepts-checked` |                             | Every concept of a required class has a check, built or not.                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Invariant | Automatic checks tested     | `inv.auto-check-tested`         |                             | Every automatic check whose concepts are all implemented has a test.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Invariant | Section keys match          | `inv.section-keys-match`        |                             | Each ontology section with definition rows has a key of its own, every catalogue section's key names one of them, and a key written in a heading is one code span of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.                            |
| Invariant | Judged checks tested        | `inv.judged-check-tested`       |                             | Every judged check whose concepts are all implemented has a test that runs it with a judge.                                                                                                                                            |
| Invariant | Every axis value covered    | `inv.axis-values-covered`       |                             | Every value of every axis is covered by a check, the outcome axis by each action's own checks, unless the catalogue says why the value cannot occur.                                                                                   |
| Action    | Derive blind                | `action.derive-blind`           |                             | Someone who sees only the ontology and the catalogue says what should happen in a case the catalogue does not hold; a mismatch with the owner's answer adds a check, or an open question when the owner does not know.                 |

| Check                               | Concepts                                                 | GIVEN                                                                                                           | WHEN                                                                         | THEN                                                                                                                                                                  | Proof  |
| ----------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.check.duplicate`             | `inv.check-ids-unique`                                   | two catalogue rows share a check ID                                                                             | the check runs                                                               | it names the ID and fails                                                                                                                                             | auto   |
| `check.check.wrong-section`         | `inv.check-in-its-section`                               | `check.loan.cancel` sits under Hold                                                                             | the check runs                                                               | it names the check and its section, and fails                                                                                                                         | auto   |
| `check.check.section-key`           | `inv.check-in-its-section`                               | the Loan sections of the ontology and the catalogue are headed `Préstamo` with the key `loan` in a code span    | the check runs                                                               | `check.loan.*` sits in its section, and `--gap` lists its untested checks under that section                                                                          | auto   |
| `check.check.section-key-unmatched` | `inv.section-keys-match`                                 | the ontology's Hold section is headed `Reserva` without a key and the catalogue's `Reserva` with the key `hold` | the check runs, then `--gap` runs with a ticket that lists a hold check      | the check names the catalogue section and its key, and fails; `--gap` lists the check apart and counts it                                                             | auto   |
| `check.check.section-key-shared`    | `inv.section-keys-match`                                 | the ontology's Item section is headed `Item` with the key `loan`, beside the Loan section                       | the check runs                                                               | it names both sections and the key, and fails                                                                                                                         | auto   |
| `check.check.section-key-malformed` | `inv.section-keys-match`                                 | the Loan sections are headed `Loan` with `Loan V2` in a code span                                               | the check runs                                                               | it names the heading and fails                                                                                                                                        | auto   |
| `check.check.malformed`             | `inv.check-well-formed`                                  | a check's proof says "maybe"                                                                                    | the check runs                                                               | it names the check and fails                                                                                                                                          | auto   |
| `check.check.required-missing`      | `inv.required-concepts-checked`                          | an invariant has no check                                                                                       | the check runs                                                               | it names the invariant and fails                                                                                                                                      | auto   |
| `check.check.untested`              | `inv.auto-check-tested`                                  | an automatic check of implemented concepts has no test                                                          | the check runs                                                               | it names the check and fails                                                                                                                                          | auto   |
| `check.check.judged-untested`       | `inv.judged-check-tested`, `field.check.proof`           | a judged check whose concepts are implemented has no test that runs it with a judge                             | the check runs                                                               | it names the check and fails                                                                                                                                          | auto   |
| `check.check.axis-value-uncovered`  | `inv.axis-values-covered`, `concept.completeness-axis`   | `action.renew` has checks for success and for refusal only                                                      | the check runs                                                               | it names the outcomes the renewal lacks, empty, error and silence, and fails, unless the catalogue says why each cannot occur                                         | auto   |
| `check.check.product-terms`         | `rule.check-in-product-terms`                            | a new check                                                                                                     | a reviewer reads it                                                          | it names members, items and dates from the sample, and no function, command or selector                                                                               | manual |
| `check.check.unreachable-reported`  | `rule.unreachable-reported`, `rule.manual-evidence-kept` | a manual check that could not be run                                                                            | the run is reported                                                          | it says not run, and the evidence of the checks that ran is kept by check and date                                                                                    | manual |
| `check.check.chosen-value-held`     | `rule.chosen-value-checked`                              | a decision that chooses a value, a requirement or the assumptions of a model                                    | a reviewer reads the catalogue                                               | an automatic check holds the value or the requirement; for the model, a check holds a snapshot of its base scenario's results, and none requires it to reach its goal | manual |
| `check.check.judge-sees-the-check`  | `rule.judge-sees-the-check`                              | a judged check of a summary the product writes                                                                  | a reviewer reads its test                                                    | the judge gets the check's case and the summary, and neither the code nor an expected text                                                                            | manual |
| `check.check.verdict-kept`          | `rule.verdict-kept`                                      | a judged check that ran                                                                                         | the run is reported                                                          | its verdict is kept outside the repository, named by the check and the date                                                                                           | manual |
| `check.check.view-states-judged`    | `rule.view-state-judged`                                 | an implemented view whose note describes its states                                                             | a reviewer compares the note with the catalogue                              | every state the note describes has a judged check whose THEN says what the note says for it                                                                           | manual |
| `check.check.screen-kept`           | `rule.screens-kept`                                      | `JUDGE_SCREENS` names a directory                                                                               | a judged test keeps the screen of `view.member.loans` in its empty state     | the directory holds a file named by the date, the view and the state, with the snapshot; without `JUDGE_SCREENS` nothing is written                                   | auto   |
| `check.check.screens-outside`       | `rule.screens-kept`                                      | a run of a view's judged checks                                                                                 | a reviewer looks for its screens                                             | they are outside the repository, named by view, state and date, and the owner can open them                                                                           | manual |
| `check.check.redundant`             | `rule.check-not-redundant`                               | two checks of `action.renew` whose cases differ only in the member and the title                                | a reviewer reads the catalogue                                               | one of them goes                                                                                                                                                      | manual |
| `check.check.blind-derivation`      | `action.derive-blind`                                    | a case the catalogue does not hold, with the owner's answer kept outside the catalogue                          | someone who sees only the ontology and the catalogue says what should happen | it matches the owner's answer; a mismatch adds a check, or an open question when the owner does not know the answer                                                   | manual |

## Manual run

| Kind      | Term                                      | ID                             | Type                                       | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Manual run                                | `ent.manual-run`               |                                            | A record that a manual check was run on a change: one file in the directory the configuration names under manualRuns.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Field     | Time                                      | `field.manual-run.time`        | datetime                                   | When the check ran, in UTC to the second; it orders the runs of a check.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Field     | Commit                                    | `field.manual-run.commit`      | text                                       | The commit or the range of commits the check ran on.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Field     | Stamp                                     | `field.manual-run.stamp`       | text                                       | The stamp of the check's case and its concepts when it ran, as --review prints it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Field     | Verdict                                   | `field.manual-run.verdict`     | one of pass, fail, not-run, not-applicable | What the run found; not-run and not-applicable say why the check was not carried out.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Field     | By                                        | `field.manual-run.by`          | text                                       | Who ran it: a person, or a model and its provider.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Field     | Evidence                                  | `field.manual-run.evidence`    | text optional                              | Where the evidence is, outside the repository.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Relation  | Check                                     | `edge.manual-run.check`        | ref ent.check                              | The check that ran, from the project's catalogue or the approach's.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Derived   | Current run                               | `derived.current-run`          |                                            | The latest run of a check, by time and then by file name, whose verdict is pass or fail and whose stamp is the check's stamp now.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Rule      | Run recorded                              | `rule.run-recorded`            |                                            | Every verdict of a review is recorded as a manual run, and the record links to the evidence, which stays outside the repository.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Rule      | Records in English, inside the repository | `rule.records-english-in-repo` |                                            | A record of a manual run or of a round of review holds no path outside the repository: no absolute path, and no path that leaves it by ..; a URL of the web is allowed, and what is kept outside the repository is named in words. Where the configuration sets records.latinOnly, its text holds Latin letters only, a project's rule of language.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Invariant | Manual checks run                         | `inv.manual-checks-run`        |                                            | When the configuration sets manualRuns.require, every manual check of implemented concepts has a current run, pass or fail.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Invariant | Runs well formed                          | `inv.manual-runs-well-formed`  |                                            | Every record gives once each a known check, one of the catalogue or one the Retired IDs table retires, whose runs are then history and never current, a verdict, a real time in UTC, a commit, a stamp and an author, its file name is its time and check, and no two records share the check, the time and the author.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Action    | Record the verdicts                       | `action.record-verdicts`       |                                            | Write the records of a review from the reviewer's table of verdicts: one record for each new verdict, with the stamp and the commit --review gives; a verdict carried from an earlier round names the record it carries and the files read for it, and writes none. The table is refused when it names a check the review does not list or names one twice, when a listed check has neither a new verdict nor a carried one, when a carried record is not of that check or its stamp is not the check's stamp now, when a carried verdict names no files, was given on uncommitted changes or one of its files changed since the record's commit, and when the check of errors in code is carried. |

| Check                              | Concepts                                                                                       | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | WHEN                                                 | THEN                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Proof  |
| ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.manual-run.none`            | `derived.current-run`, `inv.manual-checks-run`                                                 | the example sets `manualRuns` without `require`, and no record names `check.loan.overdue-in-real-time`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | the check runs                                       | it lists the check as information and passes                                                                                                                                                                                     | auto   |
| `check.manual-run.current-pass`    | `derived.current-run`                                                                          | a record of `check.loan.overdue-in-real-time` with verdict pass and the stamp `--review` prints for it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | the check runs                                       | it does not list the check                                                                                                                                                                                                       | auto   |
| `check.manual-run.stale`           | `derived.current-run`, `field.manual-run.stamp`                                                | a pass of `check.loan.overdue-in-real-time` whose stamp was taken before `derived.overdue` changed                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | the check runs                                       | it lists the check as without a current run                                                                                                                                                                                      | auto   |
| `check.manual-run.last-failed`     | `derived.current-run`, `inv.manual-checks-run`                                                 | the configuration sets `require`, and the latest current run of the check is a fail                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | the check runs                                       | it lists the check as failed at its last run, as information, and passes                                                                                                                                                         | auto   |
| `check.manual-run.not-run-ignored` | `derived.current-run`, `field.manual-run.verdict`                                              | the only record of the check has verdict not-run                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | the check runs                                       | it lists the check as without a current run                                                                                                                                                                                      | auto   |
| `check.manual-run.required`        | `inv.manual-checks-run`                                                                        | the configuration sets `require`, and no record names the check                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | the check runs                                       | it fails and names the check                                                                                                                                                                                                     | auto   |
| `check.manual-run.malformed`       | `inv.manual-runs-well-formed`, `edge.manual-run.check`, `field.manual-run.time`                | a record names a check the catalogue does not have or a verdict outside the four, lacks its commit, gives a field twice, has a time that is no real UTC time, or a file name that is not its time and check                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | the check runs                                       | it fails and names the file and what is wrong                                                                                                                                                                                    | auto   |
| `check.manual-run.same-day`        | `derived.current-run`, `field.manual-run.time`                                                 | two current runs of the check on one day, a fail at 09:00 and a pass at 15:00                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | the check runs, then again with the verdicts swapped | the first time it does not list the check; the second time it lists it as failed at its last run                                                                                                                                 | auto   |
| `check.manual-run.ambiguous`       | `inv.manual-runs-well-formed`                                                                  | two records of the same check with the same time and author                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | the check runs                                       | it fails and names both files                                                                                                                                                                                                    | auto   |
| `check.manual-run.recorded`        | `rule.run-recorded`                                                                            | a review of a change in a project that sets `manualRuns`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | a reviewer looks for its records                     | every verdict of the review has a record, and each record that needs evidence links to it outside the repository                                                                                                                 | manual |
| `check.manual-run.record-verdicts` | `action.record-verdicts`, `rule.run-recorded`                                                  | a review lists two checks, and the reviewer's table gives one a pass and carries the other from a record of it at its stamp now                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | the tool records the table                           | it writes one record, of the pass, with the review's stamp and commit, and none for the carried verdict                                                                                                                          | auto   |
| `check.manual-run.record-refused`  | `action.record-verdicts`                                                                       | tables that name a check the review does not list, name a check twice, leave a listed check without a verdict, carry a record of another stamp, carry one without the files read for it or with a file changed since its commit, or carry the check of errors in code                                                                                                                                                            | the tool records each table                          | it names the problem, writes no record and fails                                                                                                                                                                                 | auto   |
| `check.manual-run.english-in-repo` | `rule.records-english-in-repo`, `ent.manual-run`, `ent.review-round`, `action.record-verdicts` | in a project that sets `records.latinOnly`: a record of a run whose evidence holds a Cyrillic word, one that names `/home/x/notes.md`, one that names `../outside/log.md`, a record of a round whose finding names `/tmp/log`, a clean record that links to a URL, and a table of verdicts whose evidence holds a Cyrillic word; in a project that does not, a record with a Cyrillic word and one that names `/home/x/notes.md` | the check runs, and the tool records the table       | it names each bad record, its file and its line, and fails; it says nothing of the clean one; it refuses the table, names its line and writes no record; without the key, the Cyrillic word passes and the path is still refused | auto   |
| `check.manual-run.retired-check`   | `inv.manual-runs-well-formed`, `ent.retired-id`                                                | a record of a run of a check that the Retired IDs table retires                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | the check runs                                       | the record is read and is no current run of any check, and the check passes                                                                                                                                                      | auto   |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Derived   | Next round                | `derived.next-round`                |                                        | What follows the last round by time of a step of a task, from its records, by branches in this order, the review of the result, once the statement has been reviewed by version, only under an approval in force, without which work is not allowed (rule.work-under-approval): with no round, the first round; a round of the review of the result with no finding on merging and no verdict of acceptance, a round that gives it; one with no finding in either verdict whose verdict of acceptance is refused by inv.acceptance-after-done, a round whose verdict holds; each of these three a question to the owner instead when the task's budget with its reserve is exhausted; a clean round, with no finding of the change in either verdict, ends the step, a clean round of the review of the result ending the task even past the budget; with the budget with its reserve exhausted, a question to the owner; a finding not fixable, a question to the owner; stagnation, when the last round has an important finding and either an important class of it was an important finding of an earlier round of the step or it has no fewer important classes than the round before it, the next is to change the design of the solution, not to patch it, naming the repeated classes, then a full round; otherwise another round, narrow when every finding of the last round is fixed with a test and full when not. Rounds are compared only after the last end of the step: its last round that ended it, a clean round of the statement or a clean round of the result whose verdict of acceptance held, judged by the records as they were when it was given and for the version that round read, never against a statement given later, or the owner's last record of approval for the task (ent.owner-approval), before which no round of the step is read by these branches; the first round with findings after it is not stagnation. Only important findings of the change count in the comparison, never nits, findings not fixable nor findings filed (rule.findings-filed). A next round takes the next free number of its kind over every round of the step. When a record of the directory of rounds cannot be read, of this task, of another or of none, the one next action of every task is to correct it. --task, --rounds and the check give it by one function, so they name one next action for every history; when it is a question to the owner, --task names that question alone. |

A step whose applications found nothing is a candidate to simplify, which the owner decides; the tool removes nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Rule      | Findings filed            | `rule.findings-filed`               |                                        | A finding that is an unlikely case is filed in the project's limitations, docs/limitations.md, with the value limitation, and one outside the approved statement in a ticket under issues/, with the value later, in place of fixable; the last field of the line names the file, which, every symbolic link on its path followed, is in the repository and holds the finding's class word for word, or the record cannot be read. A filed finding does not make its round unclean and is counted neither in the comparison of rounds nor in the search for repeats; in a verdict of acceptance it is an error, since an item of the approved statement that is not met is not put off. A ticket of later is not a decision put off: rule.deferral-returns stays for those. Whether a finding belongs where it is filed is judged by the reviewer of the same round, before a verdict that may end the step.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Rule      | Rounds converge           | `rule.rounds-converge`              |                                        | A step has no ceiling of rounds: its rounds go on while each finds fewer important classes of findings of the change than the one before. When an important class repeats, or the count does not fall, the executor changes the design of the solution rather than patching it, and a full round follows, as derived.next-round says. The owner is asked only at a gate of his, on a finding not fixable, which cannot be fixed without changing what he decided, and when the budget with its reserve is exhausted (rule.budget-before-next); the budget is the one hard stop.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

allows a merge, a publication or the cost of more rounds is the policy of the project's owner, which the approach requires to be followed and does not set.
