## Task statement

| Kind    | Term                        | ID                               | Type          | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Entity  | Task statement              | `ent.task-statement`             |               | What a task is to do, written before work on it starts: a file with the owner's sources for it, what to do and what not to do, its condition of done as commands and its budget. Its version is the SHA-256 of the file.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Field   | File                        | `field.task-statement.file`      | text          | The path of the statement, given to the tool with --statement; the file may live outside the repository.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Field   | Sources                     | `field.task-statement.sources`   | text          | Links to the owner's words the task rests on: his answers and messages.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Field   | What to do                  | `field.task-statement.todo`      | text          | The items the result must meet.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Field   | What not to do              | `field.task-statement.not-todo`  | text          | What the task must leave alone.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Field   | Done when                   | `field.task-statement.done-when` | text          | The commands that must pass on the result, one line Done-when: each.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Field   | Budget                      | `field.task-statement.budget`    | text optional | The task's own limits of new input and output tokens, on the lines Budget-new-input: and Budget-output:, and its reserve, the multiplier of the limits at which it stops, on the line Budget-reserve:, a number of 1 or more written as a whole number or a decimal with a point, such as 1.5, each in place of the project's default; a line given that cannot be read is named by --task.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Derived | Approval in force           | `derived.approval`               |               | The one criterion for starting work and for accepting the result: of the rounds of the review of the statement and the records of the owner's approval, the last by time decides: a clean round approves the version whose hash it read, a record of the owner's approval the version it names, and a round with findings none; at a moment, the approval in force then is decided by the last of them before it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Derived | Statement state             | `derived.statement-state`        |               | What a task's statement needs next: a review of the statement when no round has read it; what derived.next-round says when the last round by time found something; when the last round is clean, or the owner approved a version after it, and the file has changed since, a full round of the new version, numbered after every full round before it; otherwise work may start. It counts no rounds.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Derived | Task budget                 | `derived.task-budget`            |               | A task's spend against its limits: the new input and the output tokens of its rounds and of the executor's records of spend, summed, cached tokens left out, with for how many contributions the spend is known; the limits that apply, given by one function that --task, --rounds, the check and the text of an overspend all ask: those of the approval in force, of the version of the statement it names, each limit that version's when it gives one, read from its file where the file given is that version and otherwise from the latest record of done of that version, a record of done of another version giving none, the file given when no approval is in force, or else the configuration's budget.newInput and budget.output, times the reserve, read in the same order from the same places, the statement's Budget-reserve: before the configuration's budget.reserve, or 1 when neither sets it; exhausted when either sum reaches its limit times the reserve, past it when either goes beyond; when two records of one contribution overlap, of this task or of another, as the check finds them, no sum, and exhausted until they are corrected; nothing at all when no limit is set. |
| Derived | Budget report               | `derived.budget-report`          |               | Each time --task runs, for each of new input and output with a limit, the marks its spend has passed: half at a spend of half the limit or more and limit at the limit or more, the limit before the reserve; printed on a line REPORT apart from the next action, which derived.next-round and rule.budget-before-next still give, so that a clean round of acceptance past the reserve still ends the task with no question; a contribution that passes both marks gives both. The executor sends the owner one report with every mark not yet reported, and work goes on. No line is printed when the spend cannot be summed, as when records of one contribution overlap, or when a line of the statement's budget cannot be read.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Rule    | Work under approval         | `rule.work-under-approval`       |               | The executor starts work, and a reviewer accepts the result, only under an approval in force; a statement changed after its approval is reviewed again before either.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Rule    | Budget before the next step | `rule.budget-before-next`        |               | The budget is checked when the next action is chosen, before every step of the executor and every round: an exhausted budget makes it a question to the owner, the one next action --task then names, with no line that lets work start or go on. A clean round that ends a step stays clean; a clean round of the review of the result, with acceptance clean, ends the task even past the budget, and the overspend is said by --task, named in the record of acceptance as the tool computes it, which --task and the check require alike by the limits of derived.task-budget, and reported to the owner.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Rule    | No default budget           | `rule.no-default-budget`         |               | The approach sets no number for a budget: its limits and reserve come from the configuration of the project or from the statement of the task, and with neither the tool says nothing of a budget.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

## Owner approval

| Kind      | Term                     | ID                              | Type                   | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| --------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Owner approval           | `ent.owner-approval`            |                        | The owner's approval of one version of a task's statement, given in his own words, as when a finding of its review goes to him: one file in the directory the configuration names under taskRecords, Record: approval. |
| Field     | Task                     | `field.owner-approval.task`     | text                   | The task, named as in its rounds of review.                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Field     | By                       | `field.owner-approval.by`       | text                   | owner: only the owner's approval is recorded so.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Field     | Source                   | `field.owner-approval.source`   | text                   | The owner's words or his answer that approve the version, with the date.                                                                                                                                               |
| Field     | Time                     | `field.owner-approval.time`     | datetime               | When the approval was given, in UTC to the second.                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Relation  | Statement                | `edge.owner-approval.statement` | ref ent.task-statement | The version approved, by the SHA-256 of its file.                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Invariant | Approval with its source | `inv.owner-approval-sourced`    |                        | A record of the owner's approval counts only when it gives a task, a SHA-256, By: owner, a source that is not empty and a real time; any other is an error of the records and approves nothing.                        |

| Check                                 | Concepts                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                            | WHEN                                         | THEN                                                                                                                                 | Proof |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----- |
| `check.owner-approval.after-findings` | `ent.owner-approval`, `derived.approval`, `edge.owner-approval.statement`, `field.owner-approval.task`, `field.owner-approval.by`, `field.owner-approval.source`, `field.owner-approval.time`, `rule.work-under-approval` | rounds of the review of a statement whose last found two findings, then a record of the owner's approval of the file's version; then a later round with findings | `--task` runs with the file, then `done.mjs` | after the approval work may start, approved by the owner, and `done.mjs` records done; after the later round no approval is in force | auto  |
| `check.owner-approval.needs-source`   | `inv.owner-approval-sourced`, `field.owner-approval.source`, `field.owner-approval.by`                                                                                                                                    | after rounds with findings, a record of the owner's approval without `Source:`, and one by an agent                                                              | the check runs with `--task`                 | each record is refused as one that cannot be read, the check fails, and work is not allowed                                          | auto  |

## Task result

| Kind      | Term                                      | ID                                 | Type                   | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

| Entity    | Task result                               | `ent.task-result`                  |                        | The executor's record of done: the task, the commit of its result, the version of the approved statement and the commands of done with their results on that commit, one file in the directory the configuration names under taskRecords.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Field     | Task                                      | `field.task-result.task`           | text                   | The task, named as in its rounds of review; it names the file of the record, so it is lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

A record made before these lines carries none, and one made before the line of the reserve carries no reserve.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Field     | Checks                                    | `field.task-result.checks`         | text                   | Each command of done with its result, pass or fail.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Field     | Time                                      | `field.task-result.time`           | datetime               | When the commands had run, in UTC to the second.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Relation  | Statement                                 | `edge.task-result.statement`       | ref ent.task-statement | The version of the statement the result answers, by the SHA-256 of its file.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Rule      | Acceptance against the approved statement | `rule.acceptance-against-approved` |                        | After done, a reviewer checks the result against the approved version of the statement, each item of what to do and of done when and the owner's sources, and gives the verdict of acceptance in the round of the review of the result; the round is clean only when the verdict on merging and the verdict of acceptance both have no finding. An acceptance by the owner that his policy asks for stays his (rule.ready-after-clean-round).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Invariant | Acceptance after done                     | `inv.acceptance-after-done`        |                        | A verdict of acceptance is given only to a task with a record of done made before it, whose every check passed, of the commit the round reviewed, for the same version of the statement, made under an approval in force for that version that is still in force when the acceptance is given, and, where the statement's file is read, for the file's version, its commands being exactly the file's commands of done; the task is done only when that record of done is its latest: a record of done made after the acceptance, of a newer result, has none of its own yet.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Invariant | Named commits resolve                     | `inv.named-commits-resolve`        |                        | Every commit a record names is tested in the project's repository by one test, git cat-file -e of the commit, and what a missing one does follows from what the record proves. Where the record's meaning rests on its commit, a missing one is an error, and the task is not done or the release not valid: a record of done, which then cannot be read and binds no acceptance; each commit the line Commits: gives as a hash of the round that would end its task, the last round by time of the review of its result, clean on merging and in its acceptance, whose acceptance holds for the latest record of done, which one function names for the check, --task and --rounds, so that all three refuse its acceptance for the missing commit; the verified commit of an entry of releases.md; and the commit of a record of a product release. An owner's approval names no commit. Every other round, such as one with a finding on merging or one followed by a later round, and every manual run, proves what it proves without the commit, which a clone made after a rewrite of the history may lack: information, naming each as a record that names a commit this clone does not have, and never a failure. A branch that Commits: names is not held to it, since a branch may be deleted after its round. |
| Action    | Record done                               | `action.record-done`               |                        | Run the commands of done of the statement on the commit, in a temporary worktree, and write the record of done only under an approval in force and when every one passes, the statement's limits copied into it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

| `check.task-result.latest-done`                | `inv.acceptance-after-done`, `derived.next-round`, `ent.task-result`                                                                                                                             | a clean round of the review of the result whose clean acceptance holds for a record of done, then a record of done of a newer commit under the same statement                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `--task` runs, and the check with `--rounds`                | the task is not done: the acceptance is refused, as the later record of done has none of its own, `--task` names that record, and neither says the step ended clean                                                                                                                      | auto   |
| `check.task-result.commits-resolve`            | `inv.named-commits-resolve`, `inv.acceptance-after-done`, `field.task-result.commit`                                                                                                             | a record of done and the round after it with acceptance clean that both name a commit the repository does not have, under an approval in force; an entry of `releases.md` whose verified commit is not in the repository                                                                                                                                                  | the check runs with `--task`, and the check of the approach | the record of done cannot be read and the task is not done; the round and the entry are each named as errors; neither passes                                                                                                                                                             | auto   |

| `check.task-result.ending-round-one-function`  | `inv.named-commits-resolve`, `inv.acceptance-after-done`, `derived.next-round`                                                                                                                   | under an approval in force and after a record of done, a last round of the review of the result, clean on merging and in its acceptance, whose `Commits:` starts at a commit the repository lacks; the same round with a finding on merging; and the first round followed by a later clean round that names commits the repository has                                    | the check runs with `--task` and `--rounds`                 | in the first, the round is an error of the check, `--task` and `--rounds` both refuse its acceptance for the missing commit, none says done and the check fails; in the second and third, the missing commit is information only, and in the third the task is done and the check passes | auto   |
| `check.task-result.against-statement`          | `rule.acceptance-against-approved`                                                                                                                                                               | a verdict of acceptance                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | a reviewer reads it with the statement                      | it answers every item of what to do and of done when, and the owner's sources, of the approved version                                                                                                                                                                                   | manual |

## Task spend

| --------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Task spend          | `ent.task-spend`                 |                        | The executor's own work on a task in one run of a model, without the sessions of reviewers, which their rounds record: one file in the directory the configuration names under taskRecords.                                                                                                                                |
| Field     | Contribution        | `field.task-spend.contribution`  | text                   | The run, by its provider and the ID of the session or task there: provider · ID; the interval is not part of it.                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Field     | Start               | `field.task-spend.start`         | datetime               | When the run began on the task, in UTC to the second.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Field     | End                 | `field.task-spend.end`           | datetime               | When it ended, no earlier than its start.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Field     | New tokens          | `field.task-spend.tokens-new`    | integer 0.. optional   | The input tokens it read that were not in a cache; left out when not known.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Field     | Cached tokens       | `field.task-spend.tokens-cached` | integer 0.. optional   | The input tokens it read from a cache, which no budget counts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Field     | Output tokens       | `field.task-spend.tokens-out`    | integer 0.. optional   | The tokens it wrote; left out when not known.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Relation  | Task                | `edge.task-spend.task`           | ref ent.task-statement | The task the work was for, named as in its rounds.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Invariant | Contributions apart | `inv.contributions-apart`        |                        | No two records, of rounds or of spend, give one provider and one session or task with intervals that overlap, even in part, or that begin in the same second, as equal intervals do, and every record begins no later than it ends; a record that begins after it ends counts in no sum and in no comparison of intervals. |

| Check                                   | Concepts                                                                                                                                                                                                     | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                                | WHEN                                  | THEN                                                                                                                                                               | Proof |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----- |
| `check.task-spend.overlap`              | `inv.contributions-apart`, `field.task-spend.contribution`, `field.task-spend.start`, `field.task-spend.end`, `field.task-spend.tokens-new`, `field.task-spend.tokens-out`, `field.task-spend.tokens-cached` | one session recorded by a round from 10:15 to 10:45 and by a record of spend from 10:00 to 10:30, and a record of a round and one of spend that begin after they end | the check and `--task` run            | the overlap is an error, the two that begin after they end are errors, and neither of those two is summed                                                          | auto  |
| `check.task-spend.overlap-not-summed`   | `inv.contributions-apart`, `derived.task-budget`, `rule.budget-before-next`                                                                                                                                  | two records of spend of one session, each starting and ending in the same second, 400 tokens of new input each, with a limit of 1000; then one of them alone         | the check and `--task` run            | the two overlap; `--task` sums neither, says the spend cannot be summed and why, and the next step is a question to the owner; the one record alone is summed once | auto  |
| `check.task-spend.overlap-across-tasks` | `inv.contributions-apart`, `derived.task-budget`, `rule.budget-before-next`                                                                                                                                  | records of spend of tasks `t` and `u` of one session over intervals that overlap, within a high limit                                                                | the check runs, and `--task` for each | the overlap is an error, and for each task the spend is not summed, the pair is named with its tasks, and the next action is the question                          | auto  |

| Derived   | Next slice             | `derived.next-slice`           |                          | What --next proposes for the next ticket: the ready targets of the first ontology section that has any, the ready targets they depend on, and the checks whose concepts the slice and the code cover.                                                                                                                                   |

| Rule      | Build what is ready    | `rule.take-ready`              |                          | Work is taken from what --gap marks ready, through a ticket; a target that waits for the owner, a condition or another target is not built ahead of it.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Rule      | Cut when started       | `rule.cut-when-started`        |                          | A ticket is cut when work on its slice starts, not ahead of it, because it takes its concepts out of what --next offers; an agent may cut it from --next, and what the agent may do then is the owner's choice                                                                                                                          |
| Rule      | Closed when done       | `rule.ticket-closed-on-done`   |                          | When --gap with the ticket prints SLICE_DONE and the tests pass, the ticket is closed and kept as the record of the slice                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

| Rule      | One change per slice   | `rule.slice-one-change`        |                          | A slice is one change that a reviewer can read with its own evidence; when what --next proposes is more, it is split along its dependencies and the part the rest depends on is built first                                                                                                                                             |
| Invariant | Names its concepts     | `inv.ticket-has-ids`           |                          | A ticket has an IDs: line.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Invariant | Related checks         | `inv.ticket-checks-related`    |                          | Every check a ticket lists exists and names one of its concepts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Action    | Cut a slice            | `action.cut-slice`             |                          | Take part of the gap and write the ticket with its limits and permissions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

| `check.ticket.take-ready`         | `rule.take-ready`                               | an agent looks for work                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | it takes the next slice                           | the slice holds ready targets only, cut into a ticket from `--next`; a target that waits for the owner is left until the owner answers                                                                                                   | manual |

## Agent rules

| Kind      | Term                             | ID                                  | Type                       | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| --------- | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Agent rules                      | `ent.agent-rules`                   |                            | The section of the agents' instructions that says what else to update when something changes, and what to run.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Field     | Files                            | `field.agent-rules.files`           | text                       | The files that hold the agents' instructions, listed in the configuration under agentInstructions; the check reads the IDs and entries they mention.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Relation  | Sources                          | `edge.agent-rules.sources`          | refs ent.decision optional | The entries the instructions name as the source of their rules.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Derived   | Checks to review                 | `derived.review-checks`             |                            | The manual checks a change touches: the project's checks whose concepts its definition rows, its checks, its code, its doc sections, its tickets or its files under a directory of reviewPaths touch, and the approach's checks for the kinds of artifact it changes; the approach's checks of a judge and of the screens only when the change touches a judge, a file of code that names it, its verdicts, a judged check, a view or a screen, or when a changed file is nothing the configuration describes; files under the directories of manualRuns and reviewRounds are the review's own records and touch nothing; --review <base> lists them. |
| Concept   | Approach IDs                     | `concept.approach-ids`              |                            | The approach's concept IDs, retired IDs and manual checks, generated into tools/ont-check/approach.json and copied with the tool, so that a project's check resolves the rules of the approach.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Rule      | Short                            | `rule.agent-rules-short`            |                            | The section is short enough to be read at the start of every session.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Rule      | Points at files                  | `rule.agent-rules-point-at-files`   |                            | Every row names a path or a command.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Rule      | Start from IDs                   | `rule.start-from-ids`               |                            | Every task starts by naming the IDs it touches; a task that cannot is not about meaning, or the ontology is incomplete.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Rule      | Findings that matter             | `rule.findings-mislead`             |                            | A consistency review reports what would mislead a reader or an agent, or would break a check. Style, the completeness of lists and compliance that changes nothing are not findings.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Rule      | Every change committed           | `rule.commit-finished-work`         |                            | Every change ends with a commit of its own files; who approves a commit or a push is the user's choice.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Rule      | Rule names its source            | `rule.agent-rule-source`            |                            | A process rule in the agent instructions that comes from a rule of the approach or from a decision names that rule's ID or that entry; commands and matters of style name nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Rule      | Departure by entry               | `rule.departure-by-entry`           |                            | A project departs from a rule of the approach, stricter or looser, only by a process entry that extends or overrides it, and the instruction that departs cites that entry.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Rule      | Strongest step                   | `rule.strongest-step`               |                            | A correction of an agent is held at the strongest step that can hold it: the structure of the code, so the mistake cannot be written; then a check of the tool, a test or a lint; then a rule in the agent instructions; a reviewer's memory last                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Rule      | Reviewed before merge            | `rule.reviewed-before-merge`        |                            | Before a change is merged, an agent of another provider that did not write it gives each of its checks to review a verdict: pass, fail, not run with the reason, or not applicable with the reason. A verdict counts while the stamp it was given at is the check's stamp now and the commits since change none of the files it read; the check of errors in code is given again on each new diff. A fail, or a finding of the change that remains, stops the merge; a not run with its reason does not stop it on its own.                                                                                                                           |
| Rule      | Value checked against its source | `rule.value-checked-against-source` |                            | In a project whose values carry a source, a change that adds or alters such a value is reviewed against the source: the reviewer opens it and gives the project's check of values against their source a verdict, recorded as a manual run.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Rule      | Code reviewed for errors         | `rule.code-reviewed-for-errors`     |                            | The reviewer of a change that touches code reads the diff for errors of correctness and for security problems and gives the approach's check of them a verdict; a change that brings one of them fails it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Invariant | Instruction references resolve   | `inv.agent-rule-references-resolve` |                            | Every concept ID the agent instructions mention is defined, in the project's ontology or the approach's, and not retired; every entry they cite exists and is in force.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
