## Ontology tree

| Kind      | Term                    | ID                                | Type             | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| --------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Ontology tree           | `ent.ontology-tree`               |                  | A page for people that shows the whole ontology as a tree: each entity with the rows of its table by kind, and a table without an entity under its heading. Written by a generator when someone wants to see the ontology, and by the protocol's hook after a merge into main in a clone that names its place; never kept in the repository.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Field     | Place                   | `field.ontology-tree.place`       | text optional    | Where a clone keeps its tree: a path in the clone's own Git configuration, ont.treeOut, never in ont.config.json, so that no path of one machine reaches the repository. Without it, no tree is refreshed and none is reported stale. The place is the file of its name in its directory as the file system resolves that directory, links and .. on the way followed; a place whose directory does not exist is refused. That file is refused with the reason, and nothing is written, when it lies inside a working tree of the repository, any of them, or its Git directory, so that a wrong setting never overwrites a file of the repository; when it is a symbolic link; when it is not a regular file; or when it has more than one link, which may be a file of the repository under another name. The page is written to a new file in that directory and renamed over the place, never into the file that is there, so that a link elsewhere to the old file keeps its bytes. The stale report reads the same file.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Field     | Built from              | `field.ontology-tree.built-from`  | text             | What the page was written from, in its mark: one footer in the one form the generator writes, its text saying in the generator's own words what its attributes say, the last element of the page, directly before the </body></html> that ends it with nothing but white space between, with the SHA-256 of the page's bytes before it and of the footer's commit, configuration and date, so that the mark is of the page the generator wrote with that footer, whose footer a person sees; with the commit of HEAD, read once; the path of the configuration from the root of the repository, except outside Git; and the date and time in UTC, to the second, such as 2026-11-20T09:30:00Z. An input's path is the one the configuration gives, never normalised; a .. part on it, or a part of it, the file included, that is a symbolic link or is missing, makes it not the commit's file. The refresh builds the page from the files of that commit, and only when the working tree holds the same at those paths, so its mark is that commit. A page written on demand reads each file of the working tree once, a regular file only, and is marked +working-tree when the bytes read are not the commit's file at the same path inside the repository, or when its path is not the commit's file when the file is read or after; outside Git it is marked no-commit. |
| Relation  | Concepts shown          | `edge.ontology-tree.concepts`     | refs ent.concept | The definition rows the tree shows.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Derived   | Stale tree              | `derived.tree-stale`              |                  | The tree at the place is stale when the file is missing, is not a regular file, such as a directory, a named pipe or a symbolic link, which is reported without being opened, or cannot be read; when the page does not end with the mark in the form the generator writes, its attributes and its text, directly before the </body></html> that ends it with nothing but white space between, with the SHA-256 of the page's bytes before it and of the footer's commit, configuration and date, which is no mark whatever text elsewhere on the page, in a comment or an attribute, looks like one, whatever a footer with the right attributes says in other words, and whatever was changed before the footer, one byte included; when the mark has no commit, no configuration or no valid date of that form; when the mark is +working-tree or no-commit, its configuration is not the ont.config.json at the root, or its commit is not the branch main, refs/heads/main. It is reported and blocks nothing, a file that cannot be read included.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Rule      | Only the structure      | `rule.tree-structure-only`        |                  | The tree follows the order of the tables and the configured order of kinds, then the other classes its rows have, as an external ontology's, shows each row by its term with its ID and definition on hover, the entity a field or relation refers to and the entities a view shows, and nothing else. The rows under an entity are its table, not kinds of it. The footer of the page says what it was built from, its commit, configuration and date, and is not part of the tree.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Rule      | Refreshed after a merge | `rule.tree-refreshed-after-merge` |                  | After a merge into main in a clone that names a place, the protocol's hook writes the tree there from the ont.config.json at the root, built from the files HEAD holds, its commit read once, so that no file of the working tree reaches the page; a file the configuration names that the commit holds as a symbolic link, through one, above the root or not at all is an error of the generator. It writes only when the working tree holds the same files at the paths the configuration gives, never normalised: when the copy of a file it built from is changed, missing or not a regular file, or its path has a .. part or a symbolic link, it writes nothing, the page there stays, and it names the file. A commit is the content its SHA names, never one a local replacement puts in its place. On another branch or without a place it writes nothing and says nothing, before it runs anything else; after a squash merge it writes nothing; when the generator or a file it imports is missing it says so and names the command that restores it; and an error of the generator does not undo the merge. A merge Git ends without the hook, such as a rebase or a resolved conflict, is refreshed by the same command run by hand.                                                                                                                           |
| Invariant | Whole ontology          | `inv.tree-complete`               |                  | Every definition row is in the tree exactly once, in the branch of its table.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

| Check                                      | Concepts                                                                | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | WHEN                                                                                                                                                  | THEN                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Proof  |
| ------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Field     | Date                 | `field.protocol-release.date`     | date              | The day of the release.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Relation  | Changes              | `edge.protocol-release.changes`   | refs ent.decision | The entries of the decision log between the verified commit of the release before, or the commit of v0.1, and this one's; derived from the log, never written by hand.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

A tag that is not a release by the test of inv.release-tagged, the one test the check of the approach asks too, is said and not counted, and then none newer means none among those that can be read. Information that never blocks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Invariant | Releases tagged      | `inv.release-tagged`              |                   | A tag is a release only when it is v and three numbers, annotated, and on the release commit of its entry; every other tag is an invalid tag, said with why. ## Formal form

| Kind      | Term                       | ID                               | Type            | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------- | -------------------------- | -------------------------------- | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Formal form                | `ent.formal-form`                |                 | The behavior of a definition row in the form language: how a derived value or a rule is computed, what an invariant refuses, what an action or a hook does.                                                |
| Relation  | States                     | `edge.formal-form.concept`       | ref ent.concept | The row whose behavior the form states; the form starts with its ID.                                                                                                                                       |
| Concept   | Oracle                     | `concept.oracle`                 |                 | The ontology run by the tool from its formal forms, with actions and days as steps; traces and code are compared with it.                                                                                  |
| Rule      | Forms follow the rows      | `rule.form-follows-rows`         |                 | A section's forms sit in one folded behavior block under its table, in the order of the rows, each starting with its row's ID.                                                                             |
| Rule      | Not the product            | `rule.oracle-not-the-product`    |                 | The oracle checks the ontology and the code; it is never deployed or run as the product, whose code a model writes from the ontology.                                                                      |
| Rule      | Code compared              | `rule.code-compared-with-oracle` |                 | A project with an oracle runs its code and the oracle on the same random sequences of implemented actions; a difference fails unless it is a known divergence, and a run that compares nothing fails.      |
| Invariant | A form per row             | `inv.form-per-row`               |                 | When the configuration turns the oracle on, every derived, rule, invariant, hook and action row has a formal form.                                                                                         |
| Invariant | Forms name what is defined | `inv.form-names-defined`         |                 | Every name in a form is an ID that has a form, a field or relation of the entity it is read on, a parameter, a loop variable or a word of the language.                                                    |
| Invariant | Forms end                  | `inv.forms-end`                  |                 | No derived value, concept or rule value reads itself, and no rule or invariant names itself by refuse by, directly or through other forms.                                                                 |
| Invariant | Writes in type             | `inv.writes-in-type`             |                 | A value an action or a hook writes to a field is of the field's type, read as the contracts read it, and a relation names a record of its entity; a run that would write another stops and names the form. |
| Invariant | Code compared by a test    | `inv.code-compared`              |                 | When the oracle is on and an action is implemented, a file of systemTests registers the comparison with the oracle; what it compares is reviewed (rule.code-compared-with-oracle).                         |

| `check.formal-form.unknown-name`      | `inv.form-names-defined`, `edge.formal-form.concept` | a form that reads a field its entity does not have, and one that calls a derived value that has no form                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | the check runs                       | it names both and fails                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | auto   |

| `check.formal-form.cycle`             | `inv.forms-end`                                      | a derived value that reads itself, a rule whose value reads itself, and an invariant that names itself by `refuse by`                                                                                                                                                                                                              | the check runs                       | it names all three, each with the forms it goes through, and fails                                                                                                                                                                      | auto   |

## Trace

| Kind      | Term                   | ID                           | Type          | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |

| Derived   | Surviving mutation     | `derived.surviving-mutation` |               | A change of one line of a formal form, a number by one, a comparison turned, and and or swapped, a not dropped, true and false swapped, that the forms still read and that no trace fails on; it is a case the catalogue does not hold, or a change that alters nothing, which the reviewer tells apart.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Concept   | Code adapter           | `concept.code-adapter`       |               | A project's module that calls each implemented action in the code, reads a refusal of the code as the row that refused it, and shows the code's state as records of the ontology, so that a trace runs on the code as on the oracle; it translates and hides nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Rule      | Trace runs on the code | `rule.trace-runs-on-code`    |               | Where the oracle is on, every traced check whose concepts, and the actions its trace takes, are all implemented is run on the code, through the adapter, by a test that names it; there it may differ from the oracle only in its THEN, for a check the adapter names with the ticket of a known divergence whose line names one of the check's concepts and with the failing lines of THEN that divergence accepts, and the words of a refusal are not compared: the kind of the outcome and the row that refused are, and a judged check judges the words. |
| Rule      | Test fails on a mutant | `rule.test-fails-on-mutant`  |               | A test of a check written against a system fails on the oracle with any change of one form that the check's trace fails on; one that passes there is empty.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Invariant | Every check traced     | `inv.trace-per-check`        |               | When the oracle is on, every check of the catalogue has a trace, and every trace names a check of the catalogue. A check may instead have a line that says why it has none only when it sits in a section of views, is manual or covers the error outcome.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Invariant | Traces pass            | `inv.traces-pass`            |               | Every trace holds on the oracle.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Invariant | Traces run on the code | `inv.trace-run-on-code`      |               | Every check that rule.trace-runs-on-code asks for is run on a system by a test that a file of systemTests registers.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Invariant | No empty test          | `inv.no-empty-test`          |               | With --mutate, no test of a check written against a system passes on a change of the forms that the check's trace fails on.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
